review.cadence: per architecture change and at least quarterly

rules: Every architecture change requires an ADR or an explicit referenced amendment.
An ADR must state prototype scope and must not override NO-GO, FEATURE_STATUS.md or DISCLAIMER.md.
Production claims in an ADR are Proposed or Blocked until independent evidence is attached.
Superseding an ADR keeps the old record, records the replacement and never rewrites history.
Verification/evidence must name a runnable check or an explicit null evidence gap.
evidenceGaps: No named individual holds the Principal Architect or approver role in this workspace.
No hosted Architecture Review Board approval record is attached.
No ADR has production evidence; all accepted decisions are prototype-scope only.
